name: claude-red
tagline: Curated offensive security skills for the Claude skills system
description: claude-red is a curated library of offensive security skills designed for the Claude skills system — and usable with other agents such as Codex. Each skill is a structured SKILL.md file that primes the agent with expert-level methodology for a specific attack surface, from SQLi to shellcode, EDR evasion to exploit development. The repository includes a skills manifest, conversion tooling, an installer, and a mind map, making it a turnkey way to add red-teaming methodology to agent workflows. It is positioned as an educational and authorized-testing resource for security practitioners.
highlights: Curated SKILL.md-based offensive security skills for Claude and compatible agents
Covers SQLi, shellcode, EDR evasion, exploit development, and more
Manifest, conversion scripts, and one-command installer included
Structured methodology primes agents with expert-level guidance per attack surface
curatorNote: An agentic take on red-teaming playbooks: skills packaged for the Claude skills system that hit 682 stars and 86 forks in four days. For authorized testing and education only.
